data.name: Ander
data.gender_notes: Ander is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Andros, meaning man or mankind. In the New Testament, the name Ander or Anders appears in the Book of Acts as the name of a disciple of Christ. The name Ander carries the meaning “Man, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ander usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and faith in the divine.
data.etymology: Ander belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ander total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This name has also been used throughout history in various Christian communities, contributing to its rich cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Ander holds spiritual significance, reminding us of our connection to the divine male nature of God as represented by the name's derivation from the Greek word for man or mankind. It is a reminder of our humanity, our capacity for growth, and our call to follow Christ, the ultimate example of how to live a virtuous and Spirit-led life.
